leads.title: Engineering (YC Summer 2024)
leads.posting: Team size: 16. Building the open operating system for the automated physical economy. The physical economy still operates without a common language. Enterprise systems, factories, trucks, and robots generate enormous amounts of data, but most remains fragmented across legacy software and incompatible formats. Without a shared understanding of what is happening, even the most advanced AI cannot reliably coordinate how goods are made, moved, and delivered. Oway is building that common language. Our protocol, IOI, connects enterprise systems and physical hardware, cleaning messy legacy data and live telemetry into a standardized schema that AI can understand and act on. Through a shared API, businesses can query their operations, identify inefficiencies, and automate actions across systems without replacing their existing software. Our first model, Juno, applies this intelligence to unused truck capacity. It tracks empty space on trucks and sells it at a 50% discount to businesses shipping in the same direction. By moving freight directly on trucks already making the trip, Oway reduces shipping costs, damage, and transit times while generating additional revenue for carriers. Every connected system and shipment expands our understanding of capacity, pricing, routes, facilities, and industrial operations. As this network grows, Oway is building toward a future where enterprise software, automated factories, self-driving vehicles, and robots can communicate and coordinate through one shared layer, making the physical economy programmable. B2B, API, Infrastructure, AI, Industrial, B2B, Infrastructure, United States of America, America / Canada, Remote, Partly Remote

leads.posting: Team size: 3. Curing and preventing type 1 diabetes Our mission: eradicate type 1 diabetes. GloGlo is building an AI-native therapeutics company focused on accelerating the discovery of treatments that can prevent, stop, and ultimately cure type 1 diabetes. We are developing AI research agents that continuously analyze scientific literature and biological datasets, generate and challenge hypotheses, design experiments, and run them in a wet lab to learn from experimental results. We are building a tight "in silico <> in vitro/vivo" feedback loop that helps us identify better targets, run experiments more efficiently, and move faster toward therapies for type 1 diabetes. Curing Type 1 Diabetes with AI. gloglo 287 2 8 7 agents running gloglo Curing autoimmune diseases with AI, starting with type 1 diabetes We’re building a future free from autoimmune disease. By uniting AI research agents with experimental biology, we’re creating a continuous cycle of discovery to understand disease more deeply and accelerate the path to cures. Type 1 diabetes is our first mission. Backed by Research We study how to restore insulin production and stop the immune attack on beta cells. Our work spans growing functional beta cells from stem cells, identifying the molecules that T cells recognize, and understanding how pancreatic tissue sustains autoimmunity. We use computational models and experimental data to investigate cell replacement, immune tolerance, and treatments that act selectively on beta cells. Socratix builds AI coworkers for fraud and compliance teams so that humans don't have to spend their days drowning in alerts and spreadsheets. Today, fraud and risk teams at fintechs and banks are overwhelmed. Analysts jump between tools, manually stitch together context, and make judgment calls under pressure, often for hundreds of alerts a week. Too much of their work is slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're here to change that. Socratix gives fraud and risk teams AI coworkers that investigate alerts in real time, replacing manual reviews with fast, explainable decisions. Socratix agents plug into existing workflows and reason across signals just like human analysts to help teams reduce fraud losses, minimize false positives, and scale operations without scaling headcount. We've seen this problem firsthand. At DoorDash, Riya helped save $30M+ a year by building smarter fraud detection and investigation tooling, and at Unit21, she built products for analysts that made them 3X faster. We're able to build and sell enterprise-grade software. At Cruise, Satya built scalable AI systems powering petabyte-scale data, and at LinkedIn, he built enterprise products from 0 to 1 generating $50M+ in incremental revenue. Now, the two of us are teaming up to eliminate the manual toil in fraud and compliance. We're obsessed with fraud, LLMs, real-world automation, and the messy edge cases traditional ML has trouble handling. We believe that every fraud analyst should have an AI coworker - and the future of fraud will involve combining human-level reasoning with machine-speed execution.
